name: front plank to toe tap
description: A forearm or high plank where you reach a foot out to tap the floor. It trains core stability and hip control.
instructions: Start in a front plank with your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes.
Lift one foot and tap the toes out to the side without twisting your hips.
Bring the foot back to the start.
Repeat on the other leg and keep alternating.
